status.label: Activation failure needs process-state evidence
status.detail: Multiple shortcuts, centralized-hook settings and elevation were already tried. A current failed-activation capture must distinguish a dead launcher from a lost activation signal.

next_action.label: Request failed-activation capture
next_action.reason: Do not repeat the answered shortcut/conflict question or assume an unused shortcut is proven.

comment.body:
Thanks for confirming Ctrl+Win+Space, testing other combinations, and trying the centralized hook. The later 0.82.1 report also tested elevation and both hook modes with fullscreen suppression off and linked a diagnostic report. Those checks are useful; please do not repeat that whole matrix.

Please provide:
1. On the latest stable PowerToys, make one failed activation attempt from an ordinary non-elevated foreground app. Record the tested version, shortcut, failure time including time zone, and whether PowerToys.PowerLauncher.exe is present in Task Manager > Details at that instant. Do not restart PowerToys before checking.
2. Immediately after that failed attempt, add a comment containing `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP, identifying the same failure time. If Settings or the tray cannot open, run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys installation directory instead.

This fresh, time-correlated capture distinguishes launcher startup/exit from lost hotkey delivery; it is not a request to resend the old 2024 report. Please review attachments for personal information before sharing.

actions.label: Approve Run activation-path investigation
actions.note: Candidate only; process state must select the startup versus hotkey-delivery branch before implementation.

judgment.rationale: The shortcut and several common controls are already known, but the public evidence does not identify whether the launcher is alive when activation fails.
evidence: The author reports Ctrl+Win+Space and failures with other shortcuts: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/20904#issuecomment-1261457905
The 0.82.1 Windows 10 follow-up already tested elevation, hook modes and fullscreen suppression and linked a report: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/20904#issuecomment-2241525138
The live issue has Needs-Repro, no assignee and no Needs-Author-Feedback label.
judgment.recommended_action: Request one time-correlated current failed activation with launcher process state and fresh diagnostics.

fix_assessment.rationale: A Run lifecycle/hotkey-delivery correction is plausible, but no current failing branch or linked concrete fix attempt is established.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore Run activation delivery across launcher lifecycle changes
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: hotkey registration or its delivery to the live launcher becomes stale across restart/update, so a recognized key does not show Run. Launcher startup failure is a competing cause and must be excluded before changing hook behavior.
plan: Correlate the requested failure timestamp with launcher process lifetime and runner/launcher diagnostics to separate no process, no delivered activation, and activation received but not shown.

If a stale registration/signal is confirmed, trace Run enable/disable, launcher restart and runner hotkey registration; re-establish the registration or delivery endpoint at the actual failed lifecycle boundary without creating duplicate hooks.
If the signal reaches a live launcher, investigate its show/focus path instead of applying the hook hypothesis; add a targeted regression only for the branch demonstrated.
Test update/restart, repeated activation and enable/disable under both centralized-hook modes while preserving fullscreen suppression and elevation boundaries.
verification: Repeated activation consistently displays Run after normal restart and enable/disable transitions.
Both supported hook modes work, fullscreen suppression remains intentional, and a stopped launcher is not misdiagnosed as a key conflict.

confidence.rationale: The symptom spans versions and configurations; neither process health nor activation delivery has been isolated.

issue_context.summary: Run activation shortcuts intermittently or completely fail despite trying different keys and centralized-hook settings. A later commenter cannot activate at all even with common suppression/elevation controls checked.
known_information: Original version is 0.62.0; the author names Ctrl+Win+Space and reports only about one success in ten.
A 0.82.1 Windows 10 build 19045 follow-up supplies a diagnostic-report link and detailed hook/fullscreen/elevation controls.
A separate Color Picker comment is not evidence that all users share the same Run defect.
The current issue is open, unassigned and labeled Needs-Repro.
inferences: Shortcut acceptance in Settings does not prove there is no OS or application interception.
A live-but-unresponsive activation path and an absent/crashed launcher require different fixes.
issue_context.analysis: The maintainer's original hotkey question was answered. A draft follow-up is still owed by the maintainer, not already posted author-waiting state. Request only the current process-state/failure-time discriminator and diagnostics captured around it.
initial_investigation: Read the body and all five comments, including the answered question and linked 2024 report.
Enumerated the public timeline, including closed related #34105; no fixing PR appeared in the timeline or direct issue-number PR search.
Identified runner registration, launcher lifetime and launcher show/focus as separate ownership boundaries; none was proven responsible.
No hotkey/process reproduction was performed and the externally linked 2024 archive was not used to claim a current cause.

information_gaps.information: Current tested version and shortcut, exact failed-activation time and whether the launcher process exists then.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes launcher startup/exit from failed delivery to a live launcher.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Make one failed attempt in an ordinary foreground app and check Task Manager > Details before restarting; record time zone and version.

information_gaps.information: Current diagnostic capture correlated to that same failed activation, not a copy of the old report.
information_gaps.why_needed: Allows maintainer correlation of registration, activation and process lifetime.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Immediately after reproducing, comment /bugreport and attach the generated ZIP; use BugReportTool.exe from the installation directory if Settings/tray is inaccessible.
